file_stem: RWB E1 024 Document store and index
title: Document store and index
goal: Store every document against its case with its type, index fields and versions; legal types are write-once
why: Litigation needs one trusted home for notices and deeds. The type table, not the caller, decides write-once and retention; no store without a log entry.
ace_note: No ACE read. Documents link to Workbench cases; any person link uses person_key, a business key with no FK.

writes.note: v1 COPY_PENDING -> STORED; version chain, content_sha256

stores: Blob containers rwb-docs, rwb-docs-legal (write-once), rwb-quarantine, intake (TE-012); path {container}/{caseId}/{documentId}/v1; outbox DocumentStored (EV-16)
rules: BR3: write-once and retention come from the type table, never from the caller
BR4: a write-once document is never changed; a change is a new version
BR6: the same case + type + hash returns the existing document
BR8: no store without a decision log entry
risks: Delete or replace of a write-once document -> refused (MSG-P5-002)
Blob copy fails -> stays COPY_PENDING, 503 on content (MSG-GEN-006)
example: notice-0001.pdf, 1.2 MB, type COURT_NOTICE (write-once, LEGAL10Y), source SCAN
